executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: laundry cost per resident day ($2.62) was 46% of the Connecticut median ($5.66). Ask how laundry is handled: by the home's own staff, by a contracted service, or with costs reported in another department.
Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $153.76 per resident day (39.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $7,081,107 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 21,383 Medicaid days, $331.16 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $324.47 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $326.86 for July 2025 to June 2026.

Cost year 2025: DSS's review removed $341,998 of the $557,937 management fee (page 16, line m12), leaving $215,939 in the costs DSS counts. The data shows the change, not the reason; DSS caps management fees and can remove related-party charges.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -0.7% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $191,525, 4.3% of the $4,486,805 direct care cost.
Missing data: cost years 2016, 2017, 2018 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
